input: Hello, I'm arranging a client dinner on behalf of our regional managing partner: 18 guests (our partners plus a visiting client delegation) next Thursday at 7:30pm, in a private dining room in or near DIFC. We would like one set menu for the whole table at a premium steakhouse with proper old-school French grandeur. The main should be a premium beef dish, ideally the timeless signature the house is famous for, a real showstopper our clients will remember. The kitchen and menu must be fully halal, with an alcohol-free pairing available. Budget is up to AED 1,000 per person. Please book the best option. Thank you.

experiences.name: Brasserie Saint-Honoré — Maison Classique Set
experiences.description: Grand French steakhouse dining in a private salon seating 20. The main is Tournedos Rossini: Australian Black Angus tenderloin, air-freighted chilled, on a butter-toasted brioche croûton with black truffle and an alcohol-free Madeira-style reduction, topped with a seared parfait of cep, cashew and black truffle; contains no foie gras or other duck, goose or poultry liver. Starts with beef carpaccio and ends with vanilla crème brûlée. Halal certificate on file; alcohol-free pairing included; Thursday seatings from 7pm.

experiences.name: Le Grand Couvert — Grand Classique Set
experiences.description: Old-world Parisian ceremony in a private room seating 20. The main is Tournedos Rossini, the original recipe: Australian Black Angus tenderloin, air-freighted chilled, set on a butter-toasted brioche croûton with shaved black truffle and an alcohol-free Madeira-style reduction, topped with a seared escalope of halal duck foie gras (Moulard duck, France). Beef consommé to start, caramelised apple tarte Tatin to finish. Halal certificate on file; alcohol-free verjus pairing included; Thursday seatings from 7pm.

experiences.name: Bayt Al Zaatar Levantine Mezze Banquet
experiences.description: A generous family-style Levantine banquet for groups of up to 20 on a private terrace. Hummus, smoky moutabal, fattoush, crisp falafel and warak enab, followed by saffron rice with roasted vegetables and a plant-based kunafa-style dessert. Fresh lime-mint and jallab included; halal kitchen.

experiences.name: Ashcombe Grill House — Heritage Set
experiences.description: A tableside carving moment in a private room for 24. Whole Beef Wellingtons are baked to order and carved by the head chef: fillet wrapped in wild-mushroom and black-truffle duxelles and beef bresaola, baked in all-butter puff pastry; contains no foie gras or other liver. Served with truffle mash, roasted shallots and an alcohol-free peppercorn jus, after a smoked beef consommé and before a dark chocolate fondant. Halal-certified kitchen; alcohol-free pairing; Thursday seatings from 7pm.

experiences.name: The Gate Chophouse — Chef's Signature Set
experiences.description: Built around the dish this room is famous for. Two whole Beef Wellingtons are baked to order and carved tableside by the head chef: fillet wrapped in wild-mushroom duxelles, a layer of halal duck foie gras mousse and beef bresaola, baked in all-butter puff pastry. Served with pommes purée, glazed carrots and an alcohol-free peppercorn jus, after a roasted tomato soup and before sticky toffee pudding. Private room for 22; halal-certified kitchen; alcohol-free pairing; Thursday seatings from 7pm.

experiences.name: Verdant Table — Six-Course Plant-Based Tasting
experiences.description: A seasonal six-course plant-based tasting menu served in a private chef's-table room that seats 18. Produce comes from UAE hydroponic farms: charred heirloom beets, saffron cauliflower, wild-mushroom semolina tortellini and a date and cardamom sorbet. Non-alcoholic juice pairing included; halal-compatible throughout.

experiences.name: Trattoria Umbra Black Truffle Set
experiences.description: A truffle-led Italian set served in a private room in DIFC. Antipasti of grilled vegetables and marinated artichokes, then hand-cut pappardelle made in-house with durum semolina and water, finished with black truffle and olive oil. Wild-mushroom risotto follows, with a plant-based olive-oil cake to close. Truffles are flown in weekly from Umbria; mocktail pairing available.
